title: Mana Backlash
description: Suffer a mana-specific backlash cost when magic goes wrong in the Yrt setting.

data.description: Effect triggers at wrong time/place
Impurities cause unpredictable effects
Effect inverts (heat→cold, attraction→repulsion)
Nearby seeds in your bandolier are damaged or triggered
Physical scarring from raw mana exposure; mark the location
Seed consumes extra reserves; lose additional prepared seeds
Effect hits wrong target (friend, object, or self)
White/luminous shell fails; mana disperses wildly
Wrong particle size causes sluggish or explosive delivery
Mana feedback temporarily blinds, deafens, or numbs you
Effect spreads far beyond intended area
Endure Harm as raw mana sickens you
Nearby mana sources react unpredictably
Your casting focus is damaged
Surroundings respond to mana type
Mana colors mix incorrectly; unexpected combined effect
Casting drains you severely; Endure Stress or collapse
Effect triggers at worst possible moment later
Your location saturated with residual mana; easily tracked
Important item damaged by mana exposure
Mental magic: confused, suggestible, or see illusions
Connected to target; share their pain/sensations
Compelled to cast again immediately, despite danger
Mana use draws hostile forces or authorities
Black mana traces detected; risk Conclave investigation
Disturbing vision of consequence; Endure Stress
Cannot use this color again until you recharge at source
Mana solidifies incorrectly; creates hazard or barrier
Someone you care about suffers echo of the effect
If near equipment: something valuable breaks or explodes
Permanent mark or condition; describe how mana changed you
Summon/attract entity drawn to mana
Roll twice more; both occur. If same, make it worse
Glimpse terrible truth about mana's origin
